intended_use: Appearance-only prototype on a fixed canonical construction carrier. No structural or engine acceptance.

geometry_lock.geometry_source: GEO-01 construction geometry pilot payload, exact 0.5 m conversion

surface_materials.rough_timber: rough-sawn timber with distinct domain-warped longitudinal grain, knots, sparse tapered fissures and shallow saw scoring; explicit six-face UV orientation; no false brick courses
surface_materials.stone_masonry: hand-cut variable-scale masonry courses with nonprojecting irregular mortar shoulders, restrained granular pits and mineral variation
surface_materials.worked_timber: dressed timber with fine longitudinal grain, restrained knots and shallow flush longitudinal board seams; smoother than rough timber

basecolor.method: authored seamless procedural field guided by selected catalog appearance image

normal.convention: OpenGL +Y; Unreal import adaptation remains open

height.use: reference map and shallow relief comparison only; never geometry displacement

prototype_quality_scope.render: Blender Cycles CPU, 1280x960, AgX, 24 samples, denoise
required_checks: edge-wrap pixel comparison for all maps
open_production_checks: Unreal material import and normal convention
